answer: Trust can travel along a ridge of vouches: each established member may vouch for newcomers, building an attestation graph. A newcomer is admitted only by locking a bond in a time-locked vault, slashable if their voucher is later proven false. Sybil farms betray themselves as dense star-shaped clusters that graph analysis exposes, so an attacker must corrupt many independent vouchers, and each failure forfeits real bonds. The fable that identity is free dies here: every new face arrives with money at risk and a human willing to be punished alongside it.
